author: Inside Edition
description: You may have heard of the so-called 'Door Kick Challenge,' where people kick a front door and then take off running. One young person probably wishes he hadn't heard of the social media challenge, because he was caught in the act after doing it. The child had dreamed of becoming a cop when he grew up, and feared he wouldn't be allowed to pursue a career in law enforcement after his run-in with the law. But a police officer gave him some words of support.
title: Pre-Teen Busted In 'Door Kick Challenge' Gets Pep Talk From Cop

author: Inside Edition
description: A cute little robot named Stewie caused some big drama. The machine's owner booked it on a Southwest flight, even buckling the tiny humanoid into a window seat. A flight attendant was not amused, and called in a colleague to make sure the robot would not pose a hazard. Stewie was able to fly roundtrip. Since those flights, the airline has announced it is banning all robots from the cabin. Stewie's owner Aaron Mehdizadeh spoke to Inside Edition's Les Trent.
title: Man Buys Plane Ticket For Robot

author: Inside Edition
description: An emergency in the skies as two Navy fighter jets collided during an air show in Idaho. A crowd watched in horror as the aircraft became entangled, but then a moment of relief as four crew members ejected, and deployed parachutes. The jets fell back to earth creating a fire. The military base was locked down and the rest of the air show was cancelled. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 2 Navy Fighter Jets Collide During Air Show, 4 Crew Members Safely Eject

author: Inside Edition
description: Central Africa is experiencing an Ebola virus outbreak and CBS News reports six Americans are already affected. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern after identifying more than 250 cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. Officials say 80 deaths have already been reported. While the Americans have reportedly been exposed to the virus, it is unknown if they have been infected. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 80 Dead After Ebola Virus Found In Central Africa

author: Inside Edition
description: A cop thought he was searching for a car thief, but was surprised by a water warrior. Police in Davison Township, Michigan were called to investigate a suspicious person in a neighborhood. It turned out the persons lurking around were in the middle of a water war, and this officer was an unfortunate victim. He was a pretty good sport about the whole thing. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Cop Caught Up In Teens' Water Wars Game While Searching For Car Thief

author: Inside Edition
description: Alex Wilson-Garza from Round Rock, Texas, shares her story about having a stroke at 24.
title: Young Nurse Becomes Patient After Having A Stroke #shorts
